images.scene: Robinson, stripped to his linen breeches, hauls himself up a dangling rope by the fore-chains of the stranded ship, climbing out of the calm sea toward the tilted forecastle.
images.alt: A man climbs a rope up the side of a wrecked ship rising out of a calm sea.

images.scene: Beside the grounded ship's hull, Robinson lashes spare yards and spars together with ropes and lays short planks crossways to form a floating raft on the water.
images.alt: A man ties wooden spars and planks together into a raft next to a wrecked ship.

images.scene: Robinson stands at the top of a steep hill, a fowling-piece over his shoulder, gazing out at the sea that surrounds the barren island on every side, with distant rocks and two small islands far to the west.
images.alt: A man with a gun stands on a hilltop looking out at the sea encircling the island.

images.scene: A wild-cat-like creature sits composed atop one of the wooden chests on the shore, looking straight at Robinson as he tosses it a small piece of biscuit near his piled cargo.
images.alt: A wild cat sits on a chest looking at a man who offers it a piece of biscuit on the beach.

images.scene: On a green plain below a steep rock face, Robinson drives tall sharpened stakes into the ground in a half-circle, building a double-row fence around his tent, coils of ship's cable stacked between the rows.
images.alt: A man drives rows of sharpened stakes into the ground to build a fence around a tent below a rock.

images.scene: Robinson kneels on the shore where he first landed, carving letters and daily notches with his knife into a large square wooden post shaped into a cross set upright in the sand.
images.alt: A man carves notches and letters into a tall cross-shaped wooden post standing on the beach.
